introHtml: Felt pen holders offer a soft, textured surface that stands out from standard plastic or metal options. The material absorbs ink and resists scratches, making it ideal for high-traffic desks or trade show counters. Decorate with a debossed logo for a subtle, tactile brand impression that visitors remember. Bulk buyers in office supply or event planning appreciate the quiet, non-slip base that keeps pens organized without clatter.
